production_model: Audited ethical factories; publishes its costs
notes: About page footer: 'Clean Luxury. Better For You.'; the page also describes 'Radical Transparency' as revealing 'the true costs behind all of our products.'
US shipping: Standard 4–7 business days $8, Express $20; no free-shipping threshold stated (promotions applied at checkout).
Returns: 30 days from ship date (US and Canada); mail-in returns carry a $7 label fee, in-store returns free.
International page lists the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom and Australia among destinations.
Wikipedia: headquartered in San Francisco (move to Los Angeles announced April 2026); founded 2010 by Michael Preysman and Jesse Farmer; Shein agreed to acquire it in May 2026.

production_model detail: Partners with ethical factories it audits (fair wages, reasonable hours, environment) and publishes the cost of materials, labor and transport ('Radical Transparency') (About page)

2026-10-29 (gap page run): women's jeans products.json (3 pages), 69 regular-price jeans: waist sizes 23–33 on 62 styles, 34–35 on 6, and 'L' (long) versions of 23–33 on 8. So jeans waists run 23–35; size_range's 00–16 isn't traced to jeans.

Bags (2026-10-29): The ReNew Transit Backpack ($98) has a 15-inch exterior laptop pocket and a pass-through strap for rolling luggage; Canvas Mini Lug Tote ($168) comes with a long strap for shoulder or crossbody wear (https://everlane.com/collections/womens-bags/products.json?limit=250).
